dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, do you have any work experience?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, duː juː ˈhæv ˈɛni ˈwɜːrk ɪkˌspɪriəns?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. Last year, I worked as a cashier at a supermarket for two months.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ˈlæst ˈjɪr, aɪ ˈwɜːrkt əz ə kæˈʃɪr ət ə ˈsuːpərmɑːrkɪt fər ˈtuː ˈmʌnθs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not really. The salary wasn't very good, and I stood for eight hours a day. What was your first job, Mr. Brown?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈriːli. ðə ˈsæləri ˈwʌzənt ˈvɛri ˈɡʊd, ənd aɪ ˈstʊd fər ˈeɪt ˈaʊərz ə ˈdeɪ. ˈwʌt wʌz jʊr ˈfɜːrst ˈdʒɑːb, ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I was a receptionist at a hotel in Canada. I worked there for three years.
dialogue.reading: aɪ wʌz ə rɪˈsɛpʃənɪst ət ə hoʊˈtɛl ɪn ˈkænədə. aɪ ˈwɜːrkt ˈðɛr fər ˈθriː ˈjɪrz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Three years! Did you enjoy it?
dialogue.reading: ˈθriː ˈjɪrz! dɪd juː ɪnˈdʒɔɪ ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, I did. I met people from all over the world.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈdɪd. aɪ ˈmɛt ˈpiːpəl frəm ˈɔːl ˈoʊvər ðə ˈwɜːrld.
